visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown tabby cat is seen partially inside a white wooden box, which serves as a litter box enclosure. The lighting is warm and indoor. (2) The camera zooms in as the cat digs vigorously in the grey litter sand. (3) A white cat with dark spots replaces the first cat, entering the frame and beginning to use the box. (4) The white cat finishes and tries to cover its waste with litter. (5) A calico cat then enters the scene, climbing into the box with energy. (6) Close-up shots show the calico cat's paws moving the litter around. (7) A human hand appears holding a yellow plastic scoop, removing clumps of waste from the litter box. (8) The hand uses a white wet wipe to clean the plastic surface of the litter tray, wiping away stains. (9) A white spray bottle is shown, and the hand sprays the cleaning solution onto the litter. (10) The scoop is used again to level the litter. (11) A white cat walks across a light-colored wooden floor. (12) Several cleaning products (sprays and wipes) are arranged on a table with a cat in the background. (13) A calendar with cat illustrations is flipped through by a hand.
